## Finding

The v4 collector stopped at 19:00:31 UTC on `train-84407`,
`case-57-4obj-drop_on`. One plasticine object (E = 10,000 Pa) was compressed
under a falling object. Its 90%-core radius fell from 78.284 mm to 6.597 mm
(8.4267% of its initial value) at saved states 8/9. This correctly triggered
the unchanged 10% contraction exclusion. There was no side/ceiling contact,
point-collapse flag, or widespread degenerate-deformation flag.

A fresh replay with the original **serial** simulator reproduced the exclusion
at the same states: core-radius ratio 0.084267292 versus production
0.084266818. Thus the observed contraction is not specific to grouped execution
or background writing. This is not a material-calibration proof, and the clip
is still excluded. The inspected XZ/YZ plot and serial evidence are in
`runs/mpm-capacity-10432785/contraction-inspection/` and `contraction-serial/`.

The operational bug was that the exporter already excluded the clip, but the
campaign review then aborted the entire collection on any such exclusion.

## Fix

The new review policy keeps every acceptance threshold and eligibility flag
unchanged. It records an explicit `QUARANTINE.json` and may continue past one
isolated `object_N:extreme_contraction` exclusion, at most 2% of the chunk.
Multiple exclusions in one chunk, recurrence within ten reviewed chunks, other
integrity failures, hash/clock errors, failed controls, zero survivors and
loader errors still stop collection. Rejected clips never enter exported shards.

The final targeted runner/cache/writer/policy/operator suite passed **77 tests**,
including schedule-offset, unchanged-GPU-command and recovery first-wave gate
coverage; another seven publication tests passed. The actual failed chunk and two saved-but-unpublished chunks
were re-reviewed with the original frozen validator/consumer in separate
directories. Results: 55, 53 and 52 retained clips for cycles 84407/84408/84409,
respectively; **160 recovered clips**, both loader profiles checked, one explicit
contraction quarantine. Original evidence and failed receipts are preserved.
